SELECT c.course_id, c.mountain_id, c.course_nm, c.memo, c.create_type_cd, c.rev_no, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(c.geom) = 5179 AND GeometryType(c.geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(c.geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(c.geom) AND ST_IsValid(c.geom) THEN ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(c.geom, 4326), 15, 0) END AS geometry_json, c.length_m, c.xmin::text AS row_version, COALESCE(ST_SRID(c.geom) = 5179 AND GeometryType(c.geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(c.geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(c.geom) AND ST_IsValid(c.geom), false) AS geometry_valid FROM course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND c.del_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF c

mapper.select: WITH input_geometry AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{geometryJson}), 4326) AS geom ), projected AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN ST_IsValid(geom) AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND GeometryType(geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(geom) = 2 THEN ST_Transform(geom, 5179) END AS geom FROM input_geometry ), area_rows AS ( SELECT geom, COALESCE(ST_SRID(geom) = 5179 AND ST_NDims(geom) = 2 AND GeometryType(geom) = 'MULTIPOLYGON' AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND ST_IsValid(geom), false) AS valid FROM service_area WHERE mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ), area AS ( SELECT count(*) > 0 AND COALESCE(bool_and(valid), false) AS available, ST_Union(CASE WHEN valid THEN geom END) AS geom FROM area_rows ), measured AS ( SELECT geom, round(ST_Length(geom)::numeric, 1) AS length_m, COALESCE(GeometryType(geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_SRID(geom) = 5179 AND ST_NDims(geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND ST_IsValid(geom), false) AS valid FROM projected ) SELECT encode(ST_AsEWKB(m.geom), 'hex') AS geometry_hex, m.length_m, m.valid AND m.length_m > 0 AND m.length_m <= 99999999.9 AS valid, a.available AS area_available, CASE WHEN a.available AND m.valid THEN ST_Covers(a.geom, m.geom) ELSE false END AS covered, COALESCE((SELECT ST_OrderingEquals(c.geom, m.geom) FROM course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=BIGINT}), false) AS same_geometry FROM measured m CROSS JOIN area a
